welcome.title: Set up your library
welcome.intro: A short tour of the tools you'll use most. You can pause and return from your profile.

library.title: Add and edit games
library.intro: Library is your full collection. Search by name, choose a layout and open a game to edit it.
library.one: Start with a title. The Steam icon enables search; expand the options to choose a status or platform.
library.two: Use Edit game for dates, notes, ratings and artwork. Save applies only the fields you changed.
library.three: The star marks a favourite. Filters and saved views help you find it again.

organize.title: Give your collection some order
organize.intro: Use playlists for groups of games and Focus for a small queue of what you want to play.
organize.one: Manual playlists keep the games and order you choose. Automatic playlists follow their filters.
organize.two: Add a game to Focus from its detail. Manage lets you change the selection and order.
organize.three: Shelves shows your manual playlists with their covers. It doesn't create another collection.

progress.title: Keep track of your progress
progress.intro: Your game's Personal tab holds dates, notes and playtime. Replays keep later playthroughs separate.
progress.one: Manual playtime takes priority over Steam time, including a value of zero.
progress.two: Story and completionist estimates are hours. They are not progress percentages.
progress.three: Completed and 100% have different meanings. Statistics uses your saved records and current achievement data.

home.title: Make Home useful to you
home.intro: Choose which playlists, views, filters and summaries you want to see when you open the app.
home.one: Customize Home to add, hide or reorder rows. Removing a row doesn't remove its games.
home.two: Save row updates the Home draft. Save home is the final step that keeps your layout.
home.three: Choose a game from Playing now to feature it. This does not change its status.

discover.title: Find your next game
discover.intro: Today's picks revisits your library. The dice opens a randomly chosen game's detail.
discover.one: Daily recommendations use regular statuses by default. You can include or exclude specific states.
discover.two: Everyone shares the server's daily boundary: 00:00 UTC. Your selection stays stable until the next day.
discover.three: Choose the whole library or only the games shown on the current page. The dice never changes a game's status.

finish.title: Your library is ready
finish.intro: You can repeat this guide from your profile whenever you need it. Choose what to do with any examples you added.
